package main
import (
 "context"
 "os"
 "github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/load"
 "github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/lower"
 "github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/native"
 "github.com/system-inc/adamic/internal/javascript"
)
func main() {
 program,err:=load.Load([]string{os.Args[1]});if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 ir,err:=lower.Lower(context.Background(),program);if err!=nil {panic(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(os.Args[2]+".mjs",[]byte(javascript.JavaScript(ir)),0644);err!=nil {panic(err)}
 if err:=native.Build(native.C(ir),os.Args[2],native.Options{Sanitize:true});err!=nil {panic(err)}
}
